verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents service keys meant for AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts. These keys are decoupled from user accounts and can be scoped, which gives non-interactive headless access. Code Security also adds a CI check that keeps new issues out of pull requests. However, there is no documented CLI or runnable CI step, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so the scriptable surface is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI runner, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec, examples of pipeline integration beyond the PR check, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
